name: cryovanta
description: Room-based multiplayer game hub (max 7 clients/instance). Title #1: Neon Circuit, a competitive obstacle platformer.

scripts.desktop: npm -w @cryovanta/client run build && npm -w @cryovanta/desktop run dev
scripts.dist:win: npm -w @cryovanta/client run build && npm -w @cryovanta/desktop run dist:win
scripts.lan: npm run build && npm run start:server
